text.description_html:
Omnia 40x/xx62.32D, Nylon Sub-Rose Assembly for Omnia Stainless Steel Leversets with Round Rosettes

Omnia's nylon sub-rose assembly features self-aligning thru-bolts and fits a standard 2-1/8" bore hole. This is a self-aligning, spring-assisted rose. Available for Passage (hall or closet) or Privacy (beed or bath) functions (select function below). The Nylon Sub-Rose Assembly for Omnia Stainless Steel Leversets has a 8mm hub that fits 8mm Passage Spindle and 8mm Privacy Spindle. Only works with Omnia made stainless steel door levers.

For use with Omnia Stainless Steel Leversets only.

Specifications for the Omnia Nylon Sub-Rose Cassette For Round Roses:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Diameter: 2-7/16"
  • Projection: 1/2"
  • Fits standard 2-1/8" Bore Hole
  • 8mm Square Hub (for 8mm Square Spindle)
  • Comes packaged with stainless steel rosettes and sub-roses.

Sold Individually.
